commons_claim: Drel hunts Cassik when temperature is at most 21°C AND drel_density is at least 20; otherwise it does not hunt.
evidence_summary: All six confirmed observations fit this rule exactly: hunts at (21,20), (20,29), and (19,25), and does not hunt at (21,13), (22,45), and (23,55).
